The scalp crown band painted the face front above the eye socket to the crown (scalp maxZ 0.153 was 1.4 cm ANTERIOR of the eyes' 0.139). Midline half-width = the eye mesh's own half-width. 60 scalp polys unpainted in the face front below the hairline. The #371 rebake ran with an incomplete provider cache (the toigo t-shirt's declared t_shirt_basic_tucked.mhmat and its diffuse T-shirt_basic.png were not staged in that worktree), so garment_material_from_declared silently skipped the slot and the shipped GLB lost the t-shirt baseColorTexture — the shirt and trousers shared one factor and read as a onesie. Actor role unchanged (patient).

Issue #377 (2026-08-13): re-baked with anatomically sized eyeballs. The fitted CC0 eye was 25-34% larger than human ocular axial length (fitted 29.91 mm vs 24.0 mm, least-squares sphere fit). materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py now shrinks each eye to the actor's anatomical target AND re-seats it forward (scale about the fitted sphere centre + translate so the corneal pole keeps its world z) — the naive shrink alone recedes the pole 3.0-4.0 mm and hollows the eyes. MPFB has no eye-size parameter to wire (set_scalings is a no-op), so this is a post-fit transform in the materializer. The eye.L/eye.R bones move with the globe so the gaze pivot stays at the new centre. The child's 22.5 mm target was checked against its phenotype (height_cm 125, school-age) and confirmed. Clauses of the eyeballs contract: diameter <= 1.15x anatomy (flipped to it), corneal pole within 1 mm of its previous forward z, sphere fit residual within 3x its own baseline.
